repo_notes.author: Helmv3
repo_notes.content: Helmv3 is a Next.js 16 App Router TypeScript app for Helm Sports Labs. It contains BaseballHelm and GolfHelm, but wiki generation should prioritize GolfHelm and CoachHelm unless explicitly asked otherwise. The product truth layer lives in memory/registry.yml and memory/features/*.md. Treat those files as the human-verified feature map and use source code to validate implementation details.

repo_notes.author: Helmv3
repo_notes.content: The highest-priority feature areas are CoachHelm AI, Coach Intelligence Triage, Player CoachHelm and Development, Qualifiers, Shot Tracking, Golf Round Lifecycle, Stats and Analytics, Calendar and Events, Team Communications, Team Operations, Player Hub, Roster and Team, Auth Onboarding and Join, Settings and Preferences, Admin Platform, and Team Access Control/RLS.

repo_notes.author: Helmv3
repo_notes.content: Important code roots: src/app/golf/** for routes and server actions, src/components/golf/** for UI, src/lib/coachhelm/** for AI engines, src/lib/supabase/** for Supabase clients, supabase/migrations/** and supabase/tests/rls/** for schema/RLS, e2e/** and src/test/** for validation, scripts/knowledge/** for the feature-awareness workflow.

repo_notes.author: Helmv3
repo_notes.content: Important docs: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/v3-master-plan.md, docs/v3-decisions.md, docs/v3-design-language.md, docs/v3-testing-standards.md, docs/v3-rls-template.md, docs/v3-research-golf-domain.md, docs/OBSERVABILITY.md, docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md, memory/context/*.md, memory/projects/golfhelm.md, memory/glossary.md, and docs/ai-system/helmv3-ai-codebase-intelligence.md.

repo_notes.author: Helmv3
repo_notes.content: Known product risks to preserve in wiki output: no DELETE-then-INSERT in save/submit/sync paths; server actions must auth before DB calls; CoachHelm claims require evidence/citations; Shot Tracking feeds stats, CoachHelm, qualifiers, and round reviews; Player Hub currently has a task completion source-of-truth mismatch; Stats has unpopulated strokes-gained and putting tendency gaps; Team access is through golf_team_coach_staff and RLS.
